Book correction: The question asks for (a) diagonals and (b) triangles for each of the 3 polygons, so 6 answers. The answer key prints only 3: i) 10, ii) 20, iii) 54. 20 and 54 are the diagonals of the 8-sided and 12-sided polygons, but a pentagon has 5 diagonals, not 10 (10 is its number of triangles). Correct: diagonals 5, 20, 54; triangles 10, 56, 220.
